# fw google

> Reference of the fw google command: Google Workspace and YouTube: Drive list/export, Sheets get/update, Gmail list/draft (never sends), Calendar events, Docs…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/google/

Google Workspace and YouTube: Drive list/export, Sheets get/update, Gmail list/draft (never sends), Calendar events, Docs text, YouTube channels/videos/playlists and video update behind --apply (runs fw-google)

## Usage

```bash
fw google <drive|sheets|gmail|calendar|docs|youtube> <op> [args] [--access-token T] [--auth auto|gcloud|adc]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw google drive
fw google sheets
fw google gmail
fw google calendar
fw google docs
fw google youtube
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

The help text names these flags: `--access-token`, `--auth`, `--apply`.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
